collections.name: Mockly API
collections.description:
Management API for the Mockly mock server (default port 9091).

Set the 'baseUrl' environment variable to your Mockly instance, e.g. http://localhost:9091

groups.name: System
groups.description: Health, protocol status, and global reset

requests.name: Health Check
requests.description: Returns {"status":"ok"} when Mockly is running.

requests.name: List Protocols
requests.description: Returns status info for all active protocol servers (HTTP, WS, gRPC, etc.).

requests.name: Reset All
requests.description: Resets all mocks, state, scenarios, and call counts to their startup values.

groups.name: HTTP Mocks
groups.description: Create, update, and delete HTTP mock definitions.

requests.name: List HTTP Mocks
requests.description: Returns all currently registered HTTP mocks.

requests.name: Create HTTP Mock
requests.description:
Registers a new HTTP mock. If 'id' is omitted it is auto-generated.

The request.path field supports exact strings and path parameters (e.g. /users/{id}).
The response.body field supports Go text/template with .query, .headers, and .body context.

requests.name: Update HTTP Mock
requests.description: Fully replaces an HTTP mock. Set mockId in your environment or replace it in the URL.

requests.name: Patch HTTP Mock
requests.description: Partially updates the response fields of an HTTP mock (status, headers, body, delay). Useful for temporarily overriding a mock without replacing it.

requests.name: Delete HTTP Mock
requests.description: Removes an HTTP mock by ID.

groups.name: WebSocket Mocks
groups.description: Create, update, and delete WebSocket mock definitions.

requests.name: List WebSocket Mocks
requests.description: Returns all registered WebSocket mocks.

requests.name: Create WebSocket Mock
requests.description: Creates a WebSocket mock. on_message.match supports exact strings or "re:…" regex patterns.

requests.name: Update WebSocket Mock
requests.description: Fully replaces a WebSocket mock.

requests.name: Patch WebSocket Mock
requests.description: Partially updates the on_connect behaviour of a WebSocket mock.

requests.name: Delete WebSocket Mock
requests.description: Removes a WebSocket mock by ID.

groups.name: gRPC Mocks
groups.description: Create, update, and delete gRPC mock definitions.

requests.name: List gRPC Mocks
requests.description: Returns all registered gRPC mocks.

requests.name: Create gRPC Mock
requests.description: Creates a gRPC mock. To return an error instead of a response, use the 'error' field with a gRPC status code.

requests.name: Update gRPC Mock
requests.description: Fully replaces a gRPC mock.

requests.name: Patch gRPC Mock
requests.description: Partially updates the response or error of a gRPC mock.

requests.name: Delete gRPC Mock
requests.description: Removes a gRPC mock by ID.

groups.name: GraphQL Mocks
groups.description: Create, update, and delete GraphQL mock definitions.

requests.name: List GraphQL Mocks
requests.description: Returns all registered GraphQL mocks.

requests.name: Create GraphQL Mock
requests.description: Creates a GraphQL mock. operation_type and operation_name are optional filters. Omit both to match any operation.

requests.name: Update GraphQL Mock
requests.description: Fully replaces a GraphQL mock.

requests.name: Delete GraphQL Mock
requests.description: Removes a GraphQL mock by ID.

groups.name: TCP Mocks
groups.description: Create, update, and delete TCP mock definitions.

requests.name: List TCP Mocks
requests.description: Returns all registered TCP mocks.

requests.name: Create TCP Mock
requests.description: Creates a TCP mock. match supports exact strings, "re:…" regex, or "hex:…" hex bytes. response supports plain strings or "hex:…" hex bytes.

requests.name: Update TCP Mock
requests.description: Fully replaces a TCP mock.

requests.name: Delete TCP Mock
requests.description: Removes a TCP mock by ID.

groups.name: Redis Mocks
groups.description: Create, update, and delete Redis mock definitions.

requests.name: List Redis Mocks
requests.description: Returns all registered Redis mocks.

requests.name: Create Redis Mock
requests.description: Creates a Redis mock. key supports exact strings, "re:…" regex, or "*" wildcard. response.type must be one of: string, bulk, integer, array, error, nil.

requests.name: Update Redis Mock
requests.description: Fully replaces a Redis mock.

requests.name: Delete Redis Mock
requests.description: Removes a Redis mock by ID.

groups.name: SMTP Mocks
groups.description: Manage SMTP rules and the captured email inbox.

requests.name: List SMTP Rules
requests.description: Returns all SMTP accept/reject rules.

requests.name: Create SMTP Rule
requests.description: Creates an SMTP rule. from, to, and subject support exact strings, "re:…" regex, or wildcards. action must be "accept" or "reject".

requests.name: Update SMTP Rule
requests.description: Fully replaces an SMTP rule.

requests.name: Delete SMTP Rule
requests.description: Removes an SMTP rule by ID.

requests.name: List Captured Emails
requests.description: Returns all emails captured in the SMTP inbox.

requests.name: Clear Email Inbox
requests.description: Clears all captured emails from the inbox.

groups.name: MQTT Mocks
groups.description: Manage MQTT mock definitions and captured messages.

requests.name: List MQTT Mocks
requests.description: Returns all registered MQTT mocks.

requests.name: Create MQTT Mock
requests.description: Creates an MQTT mock. topic supports MQTT wildcards: + (single level) and # (multi-level). If response.topic is empty, Mockly publishes to <incoming-topic>/response.

requests.name: Update MQTT Mock
requests.description: Fully replaces an MQTT mock.

requests.name: Delete MQTT Mock
requests.description: Removes an MQTT mock by ID.

requests.name: List Captured MQTT Messages
requests.description: Returns all MQTT messages captured by Mockly's broker.

requests.name: Clear MQTT Messages
requests.description: Clears all captured MQTT messages.

groups.name: State
groups.description: Shared key-value state used by state-conditional mocks.

requests.name: Get State
requests.description: Returns all current state key-value pairs.

requests.name: Set State
requests.description: Sets one or more state keys. Use this to drive state-conditional mocks (e.g. simulate a paid checkout so the confirmation endpoint returns 200).

requests.name: Delete State Key
requests.description: Deletes a single state key. Replace {{stateKey}} with the key name.

groups.name: Scenarios
groups.description: Named sets of mock patches for deterministic failure/latency testing.

requests.name: List Scenarios
requests.description: Returns all scenarios.

requests.name: Create Scenario
requests.description: Creates a scenario. Patches override mock responses while the scenario is active.

requests.name: List Active Scenarios
requests.description: Returns the IDs and full definitions of all currently active scenarios.

requests.name: Get Scenario
requests.description: Returns a scenario by ID.

requests.name: Update Scenario
requests.description: Fully replaces a scenario.

requests.name: Delete Scenario
requests.description: Removes a scenario by ID.

requests.name: Activate Scenario
requests.description: Activates a scenario so its patches are applied to matching mock responses.

requests.name: Deactivate Scenario
requests.description: Deactivates a scenario, restoring original mock responses.

groups.name: Fault Injection
groups.description: Protocol-native direct fault injection, set per protocol via /api/fault/{protocol}

requests.name: Get Protocol Fault
requests.description: protocol: http|websocket|grpc|graphql|tcp|redis|smtp|mqtt|snmp|dns|amqp|kafka|ldap|imap|ftp|memcached|stomp|coap|sip

requests.name: Get Effective Protocol Fault
requests.description: Merges the direct fault with any fault set by an active scenario.

groups.name: Logs
groups.description: Access captured request/response logs.

requests.name: Get Logs
requests.description: Returns all captured request/response log entries.

requests.name: Clear Logs
requests.description: Clears all captured log entries.

requests.name: Get Logs Count
requests.description: Optional ?mockId= filter.

requests.name: Stream Logs (SSE)
requests.description: Server-Sent Events stream of new log entries as they happen.

groups.name: Call Verification
groups.description: Verify HTTP mock call counts — useful in test assertions.

requests.name: Get Mock Call Count
requests.description: Returns the call count and details for a specific HTTP mock.

requests.name: Wait For Mock Call
requests.description: Blocks until the mock has been called at least 'count' times, or returns 408 on timeout. Useful for async test assertions.

requests.name: Clear Mock Call Count
requests.description: Resets the call count for a specific HTTP mock.

requests.name: Clear All Call Counts
requests.description: Resets call counts for all HTTP mocks.

groups.name: DNS Mocks
groups.description: Manage DNS record mocks

requests.name: Create DNS Mock
requests.description: Creates a DNS record mock. type: A|AAAA|CNAME|MX|TXT|NS|SOA|PTR|SRV.

groups.name: AMQP Mocks
groups.description: Manage AMQP publish/consume mocks and captured messages

requests.name: Create AMQP Mock
requests.description: Matches on exchange + routing_key; response is published back when set.

groups.name: Kafka Mocks
groups.description: Manage Kafka topic mocks and captured messages

requests.name: Create Kafka Mock
requests.description: records are produced to the topic whenever a message matches.

groups.name: LDAP Mocks
groups.description: Manage LDAP bind/search mocks

requests.name: Create LDAP Mock
requests.description: Matches an LDAP search request by base DN + filter.

groups.name: IMAP Mocks
groups.description: Manage IMAP mailboxes and messages

requests.name: Create IMAP Mailbox
requests.description: Each mailbox holds a fixed set of messages served over IMAP.

groups.name: FTP Mocks
groups.description: Manage FTP files

groups.name: Memcached Mocks
groups.description: Manage Memcached command mocks

requests.name: Create Memcached Mock
requests.description: command: get|set|add|replace|delete|incr|decr, etc.

groups.name: STOMP Mocks
groups.description: Manage STOMP destination mocks and captured messages

groups.name: CoAP Mocks
groups.description: Manage CoAP request/response mocks

requests.name: Create CoAP Mock
requests.description: response.code uses CoAP dotted status codes, e.g. 2.05 Content, 4.04 Not Found.

groups.name: SIP Mocks
groups.description: Manage SIP method/URI mocks

groups.name: SNMP Mocks
groups.description: Manage SNMP OID mock definitions and outbound TRAP configurations

requests.name: Send SNMP Trap
requests.description: Fires the configured TRAP to its target host:port.

groups.name: Webhooks
groups.description: Outbound webhook attempt history and manual "send now" dispatch

requests.name: Send Webhook (ad hoc)
requests.description: Fires a one-off webhook synchronously, independent of any mock, and returns the resulting attempt record.
